hypothesis: H5: intact rings lie edge-on and were filed as dot_pair_thread classes

pair_budget.note: unordered pairs at 85-110 A in the whole curated set beyond the shift null, extrapolated from eligible centres to all dots

verdict.summary: Not supported. The dot population has no narrow excess of pairs at 85-110 A (g(r) is flat at ~1.02 from 70 to 160 A, window minus flanks ~0). Rod-stream dot_pair_thread classes hold more 85-110 A pairs than the whole data set has excess pairs, and anchor dot_pair classes (no thread) put 3x more pairs in the same window. Their threads carry 0.25-0.47x (strip) / 0.29-0.64x (polar) of a single duplex per A, not >= 2x. Anchor dot_pair_thread classes are 42-73 A dumbbells, too short for an edge-on ~106 A ring.
verdict.repeat_34A: not discriminating: the rod_no_dot reference shows no 34 A peak in this on-axis periodogram at 5.68 A/px, and thread middles are only 9-43 A long
